data.name: Spikes
data.description: You gain the ability to loose a volley of two spikes as a standard action (make an attack roll for each spike).  This attack has a range of 180 feet with no range increment and deals 1d6+%1 damage (if you are Medium-sized).  All targets must be within 30 feet of each other.  You can launch only 24 spikes in any 24-hour period.|STR
